Start with the class or option type you need, then open a member to see its signature, arguments, defaults and return type. Use Find a member to narrow the list. The reference follows the TypeScript implementation, including constructor overloads and accessors. Where a live scene is available, run it beside the contract and use View source to experiment. The workflow links connect individual APIs to the guides that explain how to use them together.

Protected members support extensions; members marked internal expose engine machinery and are best understood alongside the rendering guides. Physics3D
Implementation: [libs/physics/3d/Physics3D.ts](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/libs/physics/3d/Physics3D.ts).
Package entry points: `retiam/physics`.

items: Physics3D: Top-level 3D physics controller for the Retiam engine. Supports: - Rapier: SIMD WebAssembly XPBD solver with exact CCD and convex decomposition. - Box3D: Erin Catto's fast, deterministic 3D physics engine via WebAssembly (box3d-wasm).
